blurb: a toy rabbit learns what it means to become Real.
source: Text: The Velveteen Rabbit, or How Toys Become Real, by Margery Williams (1922). Public domain. Split into three parts for Chapterlands.

streets.name: The Nursery
streets.blurb: Nana has been "tidying up" again and the toys are scattered all over the nursery floor.
streets.how: Find the six toys from the Boy's stocking and the nursery, then talk to the Skin Horse by the fender.

params.label: toys found

finale.say: Thank you, little one. You asked me once what Real is. Real isn't how you are made. It's a thing that happens to you — when a child loves you for a long, long time.

params.done: The nursery is tidy again, and the Skin Horse has told you about Real.

streets.name: The Garden
streets.blurb: A long June evening. The Boy runs off to the wood after tea, and the Rabbit goes too.
streets.how: Follow the Boy through the garden to the wood. Hop over the flower borders and go round the wheelbarrows. The wild rabbits are shy — they hop away if you get close.

params.objective: Follow the Boy to the wood
params.done: You made it to the wood, where the bracken is soft and cosy.

streets.name: The Fairy
streets.blurb: The Fairy gathers the little Rabbit up in her arms and flies with him into the wood.
streets.how: Hop up from flower to flower, following the Fairy, until you reach the moonlit wood at the top.

params.objective: Rise with the Fairy to the moonlit wood
params.done: The bracken shines like frosted silver. The wild rabbits are waiting to dance.

skyRun.name: The Toy-Cupboard Tower
skyRun.blurb: a tower of nursery blocks, all the way up to the top of the toy cupboard.
skyRun.how: Climb the stack of nursery blocks to the top of the toy cupboard. Some blocks slide — time your jumps.

params.objective: Climb to the top of the toy cupboard
params.done: You can see the whole nursery from up here!

npcs.name: the Skin Horse
npcs.idle: Nursery magic is very strange and wonderful.
npcs.thanks: My tail feels quite splendid again. Thank you!

steps.text: Talk to the Skin Horse outside the Nursery.
steps.say: Most of the hairs in my tail were pulled out to string bead necklaces, long ago. A few have blown about the garden. Would you find five of them for me?

steps.text: Find the Skin Horse's five lost tail hairs around the Nursery.
Take the tail hairs back to the Skin Horse.
steps.say: Five! How kind. I'm old and shabby, you know — but that doesn't matter at all, once you are Real.

vault.name: What Makes You Real?
vault.blurb: an escape room about the whole story, in the old nursery.
vault.intro: The nursery at night, by the light of the night-light. Three locks hold the door. To open them, remember the little Rabbit's whole story — and what really made him Real.

stations.label: The toy cupboard
stations.text: Inside the toy cupboard, five of the Rabbit's memories have been jumbled up. Put them back in the order they happened.
stations.lesson: Being Real happened bit by bit, over a long time — just as the Skin Horse said.

solve.prompt: First at the top, last at the bottom.
items: Christmas morning, in the top of the Boy's stocking
The Skin Horse explains what Real means
The Boy says: "He isn't a toy. He's REAL!"
The wild rabbits say he isn't real
A flower grows where his tear fell, and the Fairy steps out
solve.hint: Christmas comes first. The Fairy comes last.

stations.label: The Skin Horse's corner
stations.text: By the nursery fender, where the Rabbit and the Skin Horse used to talk, someone has chalked a question on a little slate.
stations.lesson: Not his whiskers, not being new — being loved for a long, long time.

solve.prompt: What really made the little Rabbit Real?
options: The Boy loved him for a long, long time
He was fat and bunchy and new
solve.hint: Think about what the Skin Horse said happens when a child REALLY loves you.

stations.label: The nursery window
stations.text: Out of the window you can see the wood behind the house. Two rabbits peep out of the bracken. One of them has strange markings under his fur, as though long ago he had been spotted.

quiz.label: The reading desk
quiz.lesson: You know the whole story now: the nursery, the garden, the Fairy — and the Boy, who never stopped loving him.

vault.openText: Click, click, click. The nursery door swings open onto the moonlit garden.
vault.outro: You remembered the whole story — and what really makes you Real.

badges.name: First Book
badges.desc: Finish your first book: The Velveteen Rabbit.
